lessonMappingReview: Real catalog lessons C5-L01 harmonic oscillators, C5-L02 propagation and C5-L05 acoustic echo were read; C1-L003 instantaneous motion, C1-L005 Newton and C1-L006 linear spring provide the real mechanics transfer. Course C5, individual skills and prerequisite lists and C6 reuse were checked against the actual candidate edition.
limitations: Only assigned ideal models are verified; actual media may disperse or flow, echoes may include delays or changing paths, and real springs may damp or depart from linear elasticity.
Literal signatures bind exactly the prose read; arbitrary future prose is not semantically parsed.
Exact alternatives use a bounded rational, decimal, pi or integer-radical monomial grammar and the reviewed unit suffix. Arbitrary expressions and functions are rejected.

Rebound keys, units, sources, equivalent choices and figure scales are rejected after test-only replacement of tokens and edition hashes. The plausible false prose case is rejected by frozen reading, not a general natural-language proof checker.
AI_CONCEPTUAL remains distinct from EXACT_ORACLE. Human approval is NOT_RUN; all drafts remain DRAFT.

cases.rejectedBy: Independently reviewed physical scale or graph curve changed

primaryBeforeKeys: The same constant sound speed traverses two equal reciprocal path lengths between stationary endpoints. Total length cΔt=2d yields one-way distance, rather than mistaking total echo delay for a single leg.

propertyAudit.coverage: Wave advance per period; reciprocal echo path and constant speed; Newton harmonic reduced period; velocity and acceleration derivatives, endpoint signs, inverse physical roots, nonlinear means, affine displays and continuous scale freedom. Fresh and saved reading identity against actual package and bindings.

records.assetReview: Two separate 360 px arrows at 12 px/m show 30 m each; their vertical separation is only diagrammatic, explicitly the same physical path. Time-position origin(100,930),70 px/s and 8 px/m: reflection(310,690) is(3 s,30 m), return(520,930) is(6 s,0). Thus slopes are+10 and−10 m/s and total time 6 s. Comparison bars 240 and 160 px at 8 px/m show distances 30 and 20 m. Full native image and XML read, including all separate arrow markers, absolute zero origins and labels.
records.distractors: 60 m is total path length rather than distance to wall; 15 halves twice and 5 is the speed-time quotient, not a length.
records.manualArithmetic: Total path length is 10 m/s times 6 s, or 60 m. Divide between the two equal legs to obtain one-way distance 30 m.
records.physicalAssumptions: Stationary co-located transducer and receiver, stationary reflector and medium; identical straight reciprocal legs with the same constant sound speed, negligible electronics and reflection delays. Δt is total echo delay. Assigned speeds are ideal model values, not physiological tissue claims. Source03 is the ordinary linear small-perturbation still-air acoustic model. Continuous cross-trial coefficient is not actual propagation acceleration.
